problemStatement.plain: Is it true that the hypergraph Turán number ex_t(n, K_t(r)) is at least n^{t - r^{1-t} - o(1)}, where K_t(r) is the complete t-partite t-uniform hypergraph with r vertices per class?
whyMatters: Generalizes the Zarankiewicz problem (#714) to t-uniform hypergraphs
Determines tightness of Erdős's 1964 upper bound for hypergraph extremal numbers
Central question in extremal hypergraph theory

proven: Upper bound: ex_t(n, K_t(r)) ≤ O(n^{t - r^{1-t}}) [Erdős 1964]
Weaker lower bound: ex_t(n, K_t(r)) ≥ n^{t - Cr^{1-t}} for C > 1 [Erdős 1964]
t=2, r=2: Solved via projective plane constructions
t=2, r=3: Solved by Brown (1966) and Erdős-Rényi-Sós (1966)
Stepping-up lemma: (t-1)-uniform bounds lift to t-uniform with exponent +1
open: t=2, r≥4: Lower bound not established
Closing the constant gap C > 1 to C = 1
knownResults.goal: Prove ex_t(n, K_t(r)) ≥ n^{t - r^{1-t} - o(1)} for all t, r ≥ 2
